map.机油更换里程倒计时，按机油类型与驾驶习惯系数智能计算建议换油间隔与剩余里程，支持: An oil change countdown that derives the recommended interval and remaining distance from oil type and driving habit factors, with multi-car management and local data storage.
map.点击「保存本车记录」后，记录只保存在本机浏览器，不会上传服务器；按剩余里程从少到: After clicking "Save this vehicle record", data stays in this browser only and is never uploaded; entries are sorted by remaining distance ascending so shop visits are easy to schedule.
map.车主输入上次换油里程与机油类型（矿物/半合成/全合成），按基础周期与驾驶习惯系数: Owners enter the last oil change distance and oil type (mineral / semi-synthetic / full synthetic) to estimate remaining distance from the base interval and driving habit factor.
map.多车管理时，分别登记各车换油记录，按剩余里程排序安排进店，避免超期。: With several cars, log each vehicle's oil change record and sort by remaining distance to schedule visits before any expires.
map.营运或长途车按恶劣工况（短途、拥堵、高温）下调系数，缩短换油间隔保护发动机。: Commercial and long-distance vehicles use a lower factor for severe duty (short trips, congestion, high temperature) to shorten intervals and protect the engine.
map.全合成机油基础周期 10000km，该车多为城市短途拥堵（系数 0.7），建议间: Full synthetic base interval 10000 km; this car mostly does short city hops (factor 0.7), so the suggested interval ≈ 10000 × 0.7 = 7000 km. With the last change at 50000 km and a current reading of 54000 km, remaining ≈ 7000 − 4000 = 3000 km, so plan an oil change soon.
map.全合成真的能跑一万公里吗？: Can full synthetic really run 10000 km?
map.在温和工况、按时保养下多数全合成机油可支撑 8000–12000km，但拥堵短途: Under gentle use with timely servicing most full synthetics cover 8000–12000 km, but congestion, short trips, frequent restarts and high temperature or load accelerate degradation and call for shorter intervals. Take the manual interval as a base and multiply by 0.6–0.9 according to real conditions.
map.按里程还是按时间换？: Change by distance or by time?
map.两者先到为准。即便里程少，机油也会吸湿氧化，一般建议最长不超过 1 年（矿物油半: Whichever comes first. Even at low mileage oil absorbs moisture and oxidizes, so most ranges cap the interval at 1 year (6 months for mineral oil). A car driven rarely on short trips should be judged by time rather than distance.
